Harrdy Sandhu - The heart- throb of millions is back with yet another single "Backbone". This romantic song has been penned down by Jaani , composed by B-Praak and shot in beautiful locations of Australia by Arvindr Khaira.Enjoy this beautiful song with your loved ones.
Song - Backbone
Starring - Harrdy Sandhu , Zenith Sidhu
Lyrics - Jaani
Music / Composition - B Praak
Mix & Master - Gurjinder Singh & Akash Bambar At Saffron Studio , Panchkula
Dop - Bhaanu Pratap
Editor - Adele Pereira
